content: Property Set pattern and Inheritance When the stereotype atpVariation is applied to a superclass of the property set class, then the situ- ation becomes slightly more complex: 1. NonVariantSuperClass and AggregatedClass are the same as before. 2. {PropertySetClass1} plays the role that was occupied by {PropertySet- Class} in the previous section. However, {PropertySetClass1} now derives from a class {PropertySetClass3} , which is also tagged with the stereotype atpVariation . {PropertySetClass2} sits between those two classes.
